findings.explanation: Lean proves `FAPPLY (FEMPTY : FMap Nat Nat) 0 = ARB` by `rfl`. In HOL4, applying the empty map at 0 gives `OUTL (INR one)`. The saved equation for `OUTL` covers only `OUTL (INL x) = x` (sumScript.sml:287), so HOL4 leaves equality with `ARB` open. All absent keys share the same result for a given value type, because each is represented by `INR one`.
findings.repair:
private opaque fmapAbsentValue {β : Type v} [Nonempty β] : β := ARB

def FAPPLY {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [Nonempty β] (f : FMap α β) (x : α) : β :=
  match f.1 x with
  | some v => v
  | none => fmapAbsentValue
findings.lean_check:
import CmlTS.Prelude.FMap

example : FAPPLY (FEMPTY : FMap Nat Nat) 0 = ARB := rfl
findings.hol4_check: FAPPLY (FEMPTY : num |-> num) 0 = OUTL (INR one : num + one)
